title: Integrating Critical Thinking Skills into the Exploration of Culture in an EFL Setting
detail_en: Explored ways to integrate critical thinking and cultural inquiry into English language learning.
detail_id: Mempelajari cara mengintegrasikan kemampuan berpikir kritis dan eksplorasi budaya dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris.

title: ELT & Teacher Training
detail_en: Professional development in English language teaching and teacher education.
detail_id: Pengembangan profesional dalam pengajaran Bahasa Inggris dan pendidikan guru.

title: Training of Trainers Enhancement Course
detail_en: Strengthened facilitation, training design, and trainer development skills.
detail_id: Memperkuat keterampilan fasilitasi, perancangan pelatihan, dan pengembangan trainer.

title: Interdisciplinary Islamic Studies Summer Course Program
detail_en: Studied research methodology, developed a thesis proposal, and conducted literature exploration at McGill University's library.
detail_id: Mempelajari metodologi penelitian, mengembangkan proposal tesis, dan melakukan penelusuran literatur di perpustakaan McGill University.
